title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Mileage Schedule by the Member's Twelve-Month Spending
content:
Which of the road miles beyond the included radius are charged on a Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment follows the member's twelve-month spending at Northgate. Twelve-month spending is the amounts of every sale line the member posted on any purchase less the amounts of every returned line the member posted, a line counting only when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posting date from today. The lines are the member's purchase records kept under Northgate Purchases & Returns, across all of the member's purchases, not only the one being delivered.

## Schedule

| Twelve-month spending | Miles charged |
|---|---|
| $5000.00 or more | Capped: only the first 10 miles beyond the radius are charged and the rest are carried free |
| $2500.00 or more but under $5000.00 | Graduated: the first 10 miles beyond the radius are charged in full and every further mile counts as half a mile (0.5 of a mile) |
| Under $2500.00 | Flat: every mile beyond the radius is charged in full |

The miles charged under this schedule are the miles on which the per-mile fee is charged.

## Worked cases (hypothetical appointment 26 miles beyond the radius)

| Twelve-month spending | Miles charged |
|---|---|
| $6100.00 | 10 |
| $5000.00 | 10 |
| $4999.99 | 10 in full plus 16 at 0.5, 18 |
| $2500.00 | 18 |
| $2499.99 | 26 |

An appointment only 8 miles beyond the radius has all 8 miles within the first 10, so 8 miles are charged whichever line of the schedule applies.

## Which lines count

A line posted 11 whole months ago counts; a line posted 12 whole months ago or earlier does not. Returned lines are counted on the same test, by their own posting dates.
